policy.direct_site_label: Only a directly observed or experimentally fitted free-to-bound pKa pair with its measurement model and uncertainty; fitted values must be labeled as fitted.
policy.binding_label: A quantitative affinity-versus-pH series may test linkage but is not converted into a residue-specific pKa label.
policy.structure: No predicted replacement structures and no homologous complex presented as the measured construct.
policy.metals: Calcium-containing leads remain held until a metal-aware benchmark branch is validated.
